mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS song_id, s.score_version, s.note_count, s.default_bpm, COALESCE(j.bpm_unit, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.score_json, '$.music.bpmUnit')), '') AS bpm_unit, s.score_json, s.title, s.jangdan_id FROM songs s LEFT JOIN jangdans j ON j.id = s.jangdan_id WHERE s.id = #{songId} AND s.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id, yul, octave, hanja, hangul, semitone FROM pitches ORDER BY id

SELECT s.id AS song_id, s.score_version, s.note_count, s.default_bpm, COALESCE(j.bpm_unit, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.score_json, '$.music.bpmUnit')), '') AS bpm_unit, s.score_json, s.title, s.jangdan_id FROM songs s LEFT JOIN jangdans j ON j.id = s.jangdan_id WHERE s.id = #{songId} AND s.score_version = #{scoreVersion} AND s.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND s.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT v.song_id, v.score_version, v.note_count, v.default_bpm, COALESCE(j.bpm_unit, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.score_json, '$.music.bpmUnit')), '') AS bpm_unit, v.score_json, v.title, v.jangdan_id FROM song_score_versions v JOIN songs s ON s.id = v.song_id LEFT JOIN jangdans j ON j.id = v.jangdan_id WHERE v.song_id = #{songId} AND v.score_version = #{scoreVersion} AND s.score_version <> v.score_version AND s.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND v.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND v.deleted_at IS NULL
